swe.descriptor: Generic full-stack/product SWE (React, Node, Flask, Rails). Default when no specialized angle applies.
swe.contrast: NOT for infrastructure-ops, model serving, trading systems, or data pipelines.

quant.descriptor: Trading systems, backtesting, market-data pipelines, risk controls. FMA internship + derivatives research background.
quant.contrast: Use for quant-dev, trading-infra, fintech. NOT for general SWE with no finance angle.

mle.descriptor: BUILD the model: PyTorch, neural nets, embeddings, research/modeling-heavy ML roles.
mle.contrast: NOT for roles focused on serving/monitoring models (use mlops) or general SWE.

mlops.descriptor: SERVE/MONITOR the model: inference pipelines, model monitoring & fallback, LLM APIs, scheduling/alerting.
mlops.contrast: NOT for model research (use mle) or general cloud infra.

data.descriptor: Data engineering: SQL, ADF, ETL/ELT, stored procedures, data warehousing, analytics infrastructure.
data.contrast: NOT for software delivery or platform reliability.

devops.descriptor: SHIP software: Docker/Compose, systemd, cron, Nginx, CI/CD pipelines, Linux. SRE/platform/reliability.
devops.contrast: NOT for cloud admin, networking, or IAM-heavy roles (use cloud-infra).

cloud-infra.descriptor: RUN the systems/network: Azure, ESXi, Entra/IAM, Meraki/networking, DNS, firewalls, OT/industrial.
cloud-infra.contrast: NOT for software delivery or SRE roles (use devops).
